client_alerts.headline: Google: connected Gmail, Drive and Photos content can inform ad selection (still in effect)
client_alerts.body: Carried from last week. Clients who connect personal Google accounts to Gemini should assume that content can shape ads. **Keep client material out of consumer Gemini** and check Workspace admin settings for connected-app access.

top_moves.title: Anthropic's amended S-1 says its models may soon hit its own AI-accelerated research threshold
top_moves.body: The S-1/A filed Nov 2 adds a disclosure that future models may **imminently** cross the Responsible Scaling Policy threshold for AI-accelerated research, ahead of a November Nasdaq listing under ticker ANT. Expect stricter safeguards and possible capability gating on top models. Start capturing those terms in AI-vendor risk registers now.

top_moves.title: OpenAI signs four Abu Dhabi agreements; ADNOC to deploy OpenAI Frontier
top_moves.body: OpenAI signed four agreements at ADIPEC, including an ADNOC deployment of Frontier for energy operations. Aggregators also report that OpenAI cut its funding round to $20B. Both point to sovereign and in-region deployments, which matter for clients with data-residency requirements.

top_moves.title: Google's October recap names Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon, plus the Genie 4 world model
top_moves.body: Google's monthly roundup positions Gemini 4 Argon for complex coding and financial workflows. Carbon is still limited to select experts. Nothing is generally available yet, so **don't change client tooling** until GA and enterprise terms are published.

providers.detail: No new ChatGPT release since the iCloud Mail/Calendar plugins for Pro (Oct 27) and locked chats (Oct 20). The Abu Dhabi deals and a reportedly trimmed $20B round suggest more sovereign and regional deployments. A 'GPT-6.1 Terra' item appeared in a weekly recap, but the date is unclear and it is unconfirmed.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: S-1/A (Nov 2) says future models may imminently hit its RSP AI-accelerated-research threshold; Nasdaq listing as ANT expected in November.
providers.detail: The public S-1 was filed Oct 26 and amended Nov 2. It includes a 93-page risk-factor section and large disclosed losses. Bloomberg, CBS and NPR all expect a November listing. The RSP disclosure suggests heavier safeguards on future frontier models, which is worth noting in vendor-risk terms.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: October recap highlights Gemini 4 Argon (coding/finance) and Carbon (experts only), plus Genie 4.
providers.detail: Nothing is GA for general enterprise use yet. Last week's privacy-policy change, which lets connected Gmail, Drive and Photos content inform ads, still stands and remains the client-facing risk.
